note: Rebuilt on the shared kit (tools/concept_kit.py): K3 march, K2 dense continuity, K6 collisions, audit. Bench(60,160) fast grid cache, 29 configurations. Rings are flat housed 4.76-section annuli (9 x 8 mm) fitted along their axes; links are 14 x 5.5 Ti straps rooted on 4.5 mm lugs outside the ring races; a 14 x 6 bracket to BOTTOM's bar when J3 is off it. Spec corrections: the arm ring at s 100-160 has its axis 21-31 deg from the humerus axis and stands ~63 deg to the arm skin, so J3 is parametrised by d3 instead; branch -1 puts J2 inside the trunk. Obliquity and skin-motion maps for J1 seats are in the doc. | limiter: link 1, measured. It is a 90 deg rigid arc from the back to J2, and J2 runs between S lat +50 and -23, so link 1 sweeps the whole posterior shoulder: 5 % of its samples in band, median 31.7 mm off the skin; at rest it arches 90 mm above GH, across the top the design meant to leave bare. Overhead (elev 90-150, plane -15..60) link 1 is >= 31.8 mm inside the body and hub 2 up to 23 mm, so 0 of 17 bench poses at elev >= 140 are taken clean. Behind the back, link 2 is squeezed (12 mm inside at plane -75 / elev 30 / axial 165). J1 seat: the ray from GH meets the infraspinous skin at ~52 deg, so a flat 58 mm ring stands at 173 mm over skin at ~117 mm.
